description: Dam removal, climate resilience, and metrics of climate resilience is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Null, Sarah (deposited on HydroShare). Hydroclimate change is stressing dams and their management, altering the benefits, costs, and risks of built water infrastructure for people and the environment. Removing obsolete dams and barriers may serve as a nature-based solution to adapt to climate change-related events, including more severe droughts and floods. Coverage: not restricted to one place in the metadata. The resource was created 2026-04-16 and last updated 2026-04-16; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
